entry_surfaces./: AMOLED mobile-first ordering hub: frosted glass table header + language picker hero, live category pills, dense food item cards with live customization sheet, floating cart bar and waiter summon FAB
entry_surfaces./track: live order tracking portal: saffron animated glowing stepper (Placed → Kitchen → Ready), 3-min waiter SLA timer, live item list per seat
entry_surfaces./bill: digital receipt & bill split screen: GST breakdown (CGST 2.5% + SGST 2.5%), seat-wise or equal split tabs, 8-character verify code badge, UPI QR payment modal

layout_and_spacing.viewport: mobile-first phone frame (max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl bg-[#090A0C] text-[#F8FAFC])
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px for every tappable element (buttons, tabs, quantity pickers, category pills)
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Single column on mobile (grid-cols-1 gap-3.5), desktop preview frame styled like an elegant smartphone container or responsive tablet layout

motion_and_interactions.add_to_cart_microinteraction: Button tap scales down slightly to 0.98, triggers instant Sonner rich toast ('1x [Item Name] added to Cart')
motion_and_interactions.stepper_glow: Current status node pulses with Saffron shadow (box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.75))
motion_and_interactions.bottom_sheet: Framer Motion slide-up spring transition (initial={{ y: '100%' }} animate={{ y: 0 }} exit={{ y: '100%' }}) with backdrop blur background
motion_and_interactions.confetti: Lightweight canvas-confetti burst upon successful order placement with Saffron & Gold particles
motion_and_interactions.skeleton_loading: Tailwind animate-pulse shimmer skeletons matching exact card layout (rounded-2xl image rectangle, title bar, price bar)
motion_and_interactions.tab_switching: Smooth spring underline or pill shift on category change

accessibility_rules.contrast: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 against dark backgrounds (#090A0C, #12151B, #1A1E26)
accessibility_rules.aria_roles: Role dialog and sheet overlays have proper aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and keyboard focus trap
accessibility_rules.reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion variants in prefers-reduced-motion queries to support instant rendering
accessibility_rules.color_blindness: Veg/Non-veg indicators use both geometric shapes (circle in square for Veg, triangle in square for Non-Veg) in addition to green/red colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 frontend with Tailwind v4).
Use dark AMOLED black (#090A0C) as root background with Saffron (#F59E0B) primary accent.
Import @fontsource-variable/inter in frontend/src/index.css and set --font-sans to 'Inter Variable', sans-serif.
Render prices strictly formatted with Indian Rupee symbol '₹' and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
Implement language dictionary state for EN (English), HI (हिन्दी), and MR (मराठी) with instant toggling.

Implement full mock and interactive state management: QR scan URL parameters (?table=T-04&session=sess_10293), cart per seat, waiter call SLA timer, active order tracking, split-bill calculator, and verification code generator.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.
Use Sonner for toast notifications and ensure Toaster is placed bottom-right.
